ingredients.title: Filling
items: 1 pkg (10 oz) frozen spinach, well drained

instructions.title: Sauce
items: Sauté garlic, onions, mushrooms, and green onions in butter or oil.
Add cider and lemon juice; bring to a simmer.
Add Italian seasoning, pepper and onion powder. Simmer until reduced by half.
Turn heat to low, stir in cream, sour cream, and 1/2 cup Parmesan. Blend together and set aside.

instructions.title: Filling
items: Mix together cottage cheese, spinach, and egg.
Fold in chicken, salt, and paprika. Mix well.
In another bowl, combine Parmesan and mozzarella.

instructions.title: Assembly
items: Layer lasagna: put one spoonful sauce in pan.
Layer 1/3 noodles, sauce, filling, and cover with cheese. Layer twice more.
Pour water down edge of pan and cover tightly.
